title: Comfort Advisor Product Guide: Equipment Specifications of the Replacement System Installations Packages
content:
# Equipment specifications by package

The equipment supplied with each Replacement System Installations package is fixed by the package. The sheet below lists, package by package, the manufacturer, the efficiency ratings, the compressor and blower, the sound rating, the refrigerant, the thermostat and the filter housing.

## Efficiency and manufacturer

| Package | Manufacturer | Cooling efficiency (SEER2) | Furnace efficiency (AFUE %) | Heat pump heating efficiency (HSPF2) | Heat pump paired with gas furnace (dual fuel) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | Goodman | 14.3 | 80 | 0.0 (no heat pump) | No |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | Goodman | 15.2 | 96 | 0.0 (no heat pump) | No |
| Harbison Performance Series System | Carrier | 16.0 | 96 | 0.0 (no heat pump) | No |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | Carrier | 16.0 | 96 | 8.1 | Yes |
| Harbison Signature Series System | Carrier | 17.5 | 97 | 0.0 (no heat pump) | No |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | Carrier | 22.0 | 98 | 0.0 (no heat pump) | No |

## Comfort components

| Package | Compressor | Indoor blower motor | Outdoor sound rating at lowest stage (dB) | Refrigerant | Thermostat supplied | Filter housing supplied |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | Single-stage | Constant-torque ECM | 73 | R-454B | Honeywell T4 Pro | 1-inch filter rack |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | Single-stage | Constant-torque ECM | 72 | R-454B | Honeywell T6 Pro Smart | 1-inch filter rack |
| Harbison Performance Series System | Two-stage | Variable-speed ECM | 69 | R-454B | ecobee Smart Thermostat Enhanced | 4-inch media cabinet |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | Two-stage | Variable-speed ECM | 70 | R-454B | ecobee Smart Thermostat Enhanced | 4-inch media cabinet |
| Harbison Signature Series System | Variable-speed | Variable-speed ECM | 66 | R-454B | Carrier Cor 7C | 5-inch media cabinet |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | Variable-speed | Variable-speed ECM | 56 | R-454B | Carrier Infinity System Control | 5-inch media cabinet |

## Points of comparison

- An HSPF2 of 0.0 marks a package without a heat pump; the Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System is the only package with a heat pump paired with a gas furnace, rated 8.1 HSPF2.
- Every package uses R-454B refrigerant in the new outdoor unit.
- The lower the sound rating, the quieter the outdoor unit at its lowest stage: from 73 dB on the Harbison Essential Series System to 56 dB on the Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System.
- The two Goodman packages share a single-stage compressor and constant-torque blower; the Harbison Performance Series System and the Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System are two-stage; the two Signature packages are variable-speed.
